verdict.rationale: Docs confirm 140 region-specific third-party gateways plus built-in options (WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal, Square, Amazon Pay) beyond the bundled defaults, giving merchants flexibility to swap gateways. However, evidence never explicitly addresses multi-currency charging/support — no mention of currency switching or multi-currency payment processing. missing for 10: explicit multi-currency support documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of gateway switching workflow.
